h2: Pool Cleaning Bali – One-Off Service for Villas
intro: Whether your villa pool has turned green after a week of rain or you simply need a fresh clean before guests check in, Bali Fix handles one-off Pool Cleaning Bali jobs across Canggu, Ubud, Seminyak, Uluwatu, Sanur, Jimbaran, Kuta & Legian, Nusa Dua, Denpasar, Kerobokan & Umalas. Send a few photos on WhatsApp and we'll confirm scope and quote from there.

sections.h3: Why Villa Pools Turn Green or Cloudy in Bali
sections.text: The tropical heat accelerates algae growth, while monsoon-season rain dilutes chlorine and stirs up sediment at the bottom. Dust, pollen from frangipani trees, and organic debris clog filters quickly when nobody is running them daily. In villas with high guest turnover, waterline tiles accumulate soap scum and mineral deposits within days. These are the most common reasons owners reach out between bookings or mid-stay.

Every visit includes skimming the surface, brushing walls and steps, vacuuming the floor, backwashing the sand filter, and testing plus adjusting pH, chlorine, and alkalinity to safe levels. For green-pool recovery we add a shock treatment and let it cycle before re-testing. Waterline tile scrubbing is done when limescale or biofilm has built up. You leave with clear, swimmable water—no follow-up surprises.

Snap two or three photos—a wide shot of the pool, a close-up of the water colour, any visible staining on tiles—and send them along with your villa address and preferred time slot. Mention whether guests arrive that day so we can prioritise. We reply with a scope summary and a quote based on what we see; there's no fixed rate list because every job differs in depth. Once you confirm, we schedule around your calendar.

sections.h3: Keeping the Water Clear Between Visits
sections.text: Running the pump for at least four to six hours daily is the single biggest factor in preventing algae blooms. A quick skim of leaves and insects each morning, plus checking that chlorine stays above 1 ppm, keeps most villa pools stable through dry season. Before monsoon hits, an extra backwash helps the filter handle sudden silt loads without clogging. Small habits save you from emergency green-pool calls later.

faq.q: Do you service villas outside Canggu and Seminyak?
faq.a: Yes—we cover Ubud, Uluwatu, Sanur, Jimbaran, Kuta & Legian, Nusa Dua, Denpasar, Kerobokan & Umalas, and surrounding areas. Send your address on WhatsApp and we'll confirm availability.

faq.q: How long does a green pool take to recover?
faq.a: It depends on how far along the algae growth is; mild cloudiness can clear within one session, while heavy blooms may need a shock treatment plus a follow-up test the next day. We'll tell you after seeing photos.

faq.q: Can I just get tile cleaning without a full water treatment?
faq.a: Absolutely. If the chemistry is already balanced and you only need the waterline tiles scrubbed or the floor vacuumed, that's all we'll do—scope matches what you actually need.
